description: One JSON shape for every failure, `{ error: { code, message, details? } }`, so clients handle errors in one place.
`Hono<{ Variables: { user: User } }>` makes `c.set('user')` / `c.get('user')` type-safe between middleware and handlers.
The third argument of `zValidator`; it receives the parse result and can throw your own `ValidationError` instead of Zod's default response.
Every lookup filters by the current user; other users' resources answer 404 so their existence never leaks (prevents BOLA).
Sent with `201 Created` to point to the new resource's URL.
RFC 9457 standard error format (`application/problem+json`), an alternative to a custom envelope for public APIs.
